languageGame.question: When I ____ __, I want to be an astronaut.
“Can you change my baby’s ______? It stinks.” (= fede)

conversation.question: Can you take care of babies?
modelAnswers: Yeah, I can take care of babies.
No, I can’t. It’s not for me.

conversation.question: When was the last time you took care of a baby?
modelAnswers: The last time I took care of a baby was...
I’ve never taken care of a baby.

conversation.question: Do you know how to change diapers?
modelAnswers: Yeah, I know how to do it.
Gosh, no! It’s not for me.

conversation.question: Do you know any lullaby songs?
modelAnswers: No, I don’t know any songs.

conversation.question: Did you use a pacifier when you were a baby?
modelAnswers: For sure, I used it. / No, I didn’t use it.

conversation.question: Is it easy or hard to take care of a baby?
modelAnswers: In my opinion, it’s ______ to take care of a baby.

evaluation.question: Did you enjoy talking about babies?
